signIn.title: Detectricity
signIn.subtitle: Understand your home. Take charge of your energy.
signIn.intro: Track consumption, understand your bill and find savings that suit your home.

dashboard.deviceReadOnly: Device readings are estimates from the meter. Remote switching is not supported.

account.title: Account
account.billingHelp: Choose the day your electricity billing cycle starts, from 1 to 28.
account.readOnly: Only the home owner can edit these details.
account.invalidName: Enter a home name up to 255 characters.
account.invalidArea: Enter an area from 0.01 to 10,000 m² with up to two decimal places.
account.invalidOccupants: Enter a whole number from 1 to 30.
account.invalidBillingDay: Enter a whole number from 1 to 28.

notifications.title: Alerts
notifications.emptyDescription: Unusual usage and important changes in your electricity tariff will appear here.
notifications.fallbackBody: Detectricity flagged a change in your household energy use.

longer.title: Running longer than usual
longer.body: Over {{days}} days, a typical run of {{device}} lasted {{recent}} minutes, up from {{usual}} minutes.

standby.title: Higher standby power
standby.body: Over {{nights}} nights, standby draw in your home rose from {{usual}} W to {{recent}} W.

unexplained.title: Unexpected energy use
unexplained.body: Your home drew {{watts}} W for {{minutes}} minutes when the usual draw was {{usual}} W.

tier.nearBody: At your current pace, you could reach {{threshold}} kWh in about {{days}} days. Usage in that tier costs {{price}}/kWh.
tier.reachedBody: This tier starts at {{threshold}} kWh. Usage in this tier costs {{price}}/kWh.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.intro: Ask about your bill, your appliances and ways to save energy at home.
assistant.draftHint: Adds this question to the message field for you to edit before sending.

prompts.bill: How is my electricity bill calculated this month?
prompts.devices: Which appliances use the most electricity?
prompts.save: Where can I start saving electricity?

assistant.note: Individual appliance usage is estimated from your household meter.
assistant.error: This action could not be completed. Please try again.
assistant.voiceError: Voice is currently unavailable. Check microphone permission or type your question to continue.
assistant.planEstimate: Estimated potential: {{kwh}} kWh/month. Actual savings need to be verified.

energyNew.available: Tap the chart to inspect an interval. Gaps indicate missing readings.
energyNew.billNote: An estimate using recorded consumption and tariffs, not a utility invoice.
energyNew.notEnough: Not enough data for a forecast
energyNew.notEnoughDetail: A forecast will appear after enough complete days have been recorded.

dashboardNew.estimatedDevice: Appliance readings are model estimates from whole-home consumption.
dashboardNew.askQuestion: Which appliances used the most electricity today?

savings.noGoal: No goal for the billing cycle yet. Set the most kWh or money a cycle should take to track it.
savings.cut: To stay within the goal, cut about {{value}} this cycle.
savings.perDay: {{days}} days left, at most {{value}} a day.
savings.tariffMissing: The home has no tariff yet, so the goal cannot be tracked.
savings.simulateHint: Worked out from this device's measured use over the last 30 days.
savings.invalidNumber: Enter a number of 0 or more.
savings.noPayback: Does not pay back at the current use
savings.noRuns: No runs of this device in the last 30 days, so it cannot be simulated yet.
savings.noPlans: No plans yet. Ask the Assistant to make one from your home's data.
savings.notMeasurable: The expected saving is not measurable yet
savings.unclear: The change is still within day-to-day variation: no conclusion yet.
savings.notEnough: Not enough data: needs at least {{min}} days of readings before and after the start.
savings.measureNote: The main meter's 14 days before and after the start, not adjusted for weather.
